name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water until al dente and drain.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add finely chopped onion, garlic, carrot and celery; sauté until softened.
Add ground beef and brown it, breaking up lumps.
Stir in tomato sauce, a splash of red wine if using, and bay leaf; simmer for 15‑20 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Combine the cooked spaghetti with the Bolognese sauce, toss to coat.
Serve hot, topped with grated parmesan cheese.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water until al dente; reserve a cup of cooking water and drain.
In a pan, heat olive oil and crisp the pancetta or guanciale until golden.
In a bowl whisk egg yolks with grated parmesan and a generous amount of black pepper.
Add the hot spaghetti to the pan with pancetta, remove from heat, and quickly stir in the egg‑cheese mixture, adding reserved pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce.
Season with extra pepper and serve immediately.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water until al dente; drain, reserving a little cooking water.
Thinly slice garlic and gently fry in olive oil over low heat until fragrant but not brown.
Add red pepper flakes and stir briefly.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan, toss to coat, adding a splash of reserved cooking water if needed.
Season with salt, sprinkle chopped parsley, and optionally top with grated parmesan before serving.
